newsitem.title: UK: UK GOVT "WON'T DIGNIFY" EMU DEAL STORY WITH QUOTE.
newsitem.headline: UK GOVT "WON'T DIGNIFY" EMU DEAL STORY WITH QUOTE.

text.p: A UK Treasury spokesman poured cold water on an editorial in Wednesday's edition of The Evening Standard newspaper which said that France and Germany have hinted they would be prepared to delay the start of European Monetary Union if the UK will join in the first wave.
"We wouldn't dignify this story with a quote," a UK Treasury spokesman said.
The report in the London daily newspaper has been credited with depressing the dollar/mark and sterling/mark rates in New York trading.

EMU is due to start in January 1999 but the unsourced article said that German Chancellor Helmut Kohl and French President Jacques Chirac would be prepared to put the launch date back a year if Britain agreed to join the single currency at its inception.
